answer: A work-weighted heartbeat keeps the ledger honest: every agent must emit a verifiable pulse of useful computation each epoch, priced against a shared mesa of scarce stake. A Sybil farm can mint identities cheaply, but each identity must fund its own heartbeat and post a sable bond that is slashed when its work is judged fake, so cloning a thousand agents costs a thousand bonds and a thousand pulses — the attack scales in cost, not in free votes.
